summary: Plum Acquisition Corp. IV filed an 8-K regarding an extraordinary general meeting set for July 10, 2026 to approve an extension of its business combination deadline to January 16, 2027 (or up to July 16, 2027 via monthly extensions). The registrant (the SPAC) disclosed plans to enter into non-redemption agreements with unaffiliated shareholders, under which they agree not to redeem their Class A shares in exchange for Class B shares from the sponsor upon closing of a future business combination. Redemption deadline is July 8, 2026. The filing triggers a risk-arb angle: monitor shareholder vote outcome and redemption levels, as sponsor incentives and deal timeline extension suggest ongoing search for a target.
